labels.note: retry_all & plain callable returns None instead of flattened retry_all; combination breaks.
retry_any | plain callable returns None; composed strategy becomes unusable.
retry_always never retries; public strategy completely inverted.
retry_unless_exception_type inverts decision on exceptions; retries on the stop types.
Retries on success and non-matching causes; possible infinite retry loop.
retry_if_not_result would retry on raised exceptions instead of not retrying.
None is falsy; successful result stops retrying instead of continuing; also not bool.
retry_any | retry_any returns None; combining two any-groups breaks.
